headline: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer | Terraform, CI/CD & Production Reliability
page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead AWS DevOps Engineer
summary_html: Lead AWS DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cloud engineering, automated delivery, and production operations. Deep hands-on experience with Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Python, AWS, and Jenkins, spanning reusable infrastructure, container platforms, and application release automation. AWS background includes EC2, RDS, CloudFront, CloudWatch, and EKS, with additional ECS and MySQL experience. Leads production release coordination, incident response, and operational knowledge transfer; brings supporting experience with Chef, Tomcat, Splunk, and Nexus.

achievements.text: Built application and infrastructure pipelines, administered CloudBees Jenkins and JFrog tooling, and standardized Git controls, artifact versions, and release approvals.
Authored reusable Terraform modules and provisioned AWS environments with CloudFormation and automated deployment workflows; used Ansible for repeatable release promotion.
Coordinated incident response and production releases, automated operational tasks with Python, and authored deployment guides and runbooks for engineering knowledge transfer.

experience.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
impact: Architected and maintained scalable CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, GitHub, and reusable deployment workflows to automate build, test, and release execution.

Established Git branching, approval, and artifact versioning standards and integrated DevSecOps controls into release workflows through secure secrets handling, Terraform validation, and pre-deployment policy checks across AWS environments.
Coordinated incident response and production release support, minimizing downtime and accelerating service restoration during high-priority events.
Standardized deployment pipelines for AWS and hybrid environments, improving release consistency, auditability, and operational reliability.
Designed and implemented scalable EKS and Terraform-based infrastructure to support high-throughput vector search platforms powered by Milvus and GPU-enabled workloads.
Implemented secure service connectivity using AWS PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, and private networking controls to protect sensitive application traffic.
Automated provisioning of Databricks environments on AWS across isolated accounts, standardizing network integration, IAM controls, and environment consistency.
Automated platform operations with Python, Bash, and PowerShell to reduce manual effort and accelerate provisioning, support, and recovery workflows.
Authored technical documentation, deployment guides, and operational runbooks to improve knowledge transfer and support readiness.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Managed Docker image build, provisioning, and runtime administration to standardize containerized delivery workflows.

Improved Kubernetes release processes by standardizing deployment patterns, secure runner standards, controlled branch protections, container image validation, and pipeline checks across environments.
Migrated Jenkins pipelines to GitLab CI and modernized runner configuration to improve maintainability and pipeline reliability.
Deployed and administered self-hosted and auto-scaling build agents for Linux and Windows workloads to support high-throughput CI/CD operations.
Administered Kubernetes clusters and deployed applications through pods, deployments, services, and core platform components.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II
impact: Provisioned AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation, Terraform, and pipeline-driven infrastructure-as-code deployment patterns.
Implemented disaster recovery, backup, and observability controls using AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery, AWS Backup, and Amazon CloudWatch.
Built Docker images and deployed containerized applications to EKS using Helm charts and Kubernetes manifests.
Implemented GitHub Actions workflows for deploying services to Kubernetes clusters across multiple environments.
Designed secure VPC networking, Route 53 DNS, security groups, load balancing, VPN connectivity, Direct Connect, and traffic-routing patterns for enterprise workloads.
Authored PowerShell and shell automation scripts and published them to shared repositories for consistent reuse across environments.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Senior SRE
impact: Designed CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments across AWS environments.
Designed and delivered a Terraform and Kubernetes solution for payment-platform deployments, enabling repeatable infrastructure provisioning and container orchestration.
Implemented MFA, identity access controls, and role-based access management for users and groups across cloud environments.
Developed internal APIs in Python FastAPI to integrate Jenkins, Jira, and JFrog processes with platform automation.
Administered CloudBees Jenkins, JFrog Artifactory, and Xray enterprise tooling for secure software delivery.
Authored and enforced custom policy controls aligned to internal security and governance requirements across AWS accounts.
Developed custom Prometheus exporters in Python to capture application-specific operational metrics for SRE use cases.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Worked extensively with AWS infrastructure services including EC2, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and managed database platforms for enterprise workloads.
Supported enterprise applications on AWS by troubleshooting CloudWatch, Amazon RDS, load balancing, auto scaling, certificate management, CloudFront, and identity integrations.
Used CloudFormation and PowerShell scripting to provision and manage cloud resources in a repeatable and auditable manner.
Automated fleet-level configuration enforcement for Linux and Windows EC2 instances and managed secure access and database connectivity in line with enterprise security standards.
Planned and executed migration strategies for traditional workloads to AWS using lift-and-shift and modernization approaches.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
impact: Authored and maintained Terraform modules and executed infrastructure changes through automated CI/CD workflows.
Created CI/CD pipelines for multiple application components across shared delivery platforms.
Authored AWS CLI automation to update service configurations and standardize administrative operations.
Created deployment pipelines with Ansible to promote releases from development through production in a controlled, repeatable manner.
Managed variable groups and environment-specific configuration to separate deployments cleanly across stages.

experience.title: Build & Release Engineer
impact: Supported application builds, release packaging, and deployment coordination for the Expedia Travel Portal across development and test environments.
Partnered with developers and QA to investigate build and deployment failures, verify application smoke tests, and support release handovers.
Prepared shell scripts for deployment preparation, configuration checks, and log collection to simplify recurring release support tasks.
Maintained version-controlled build configurations and release documentation, tracking artifact versions and environment-specific settings.
